assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome
The patient has recurrent episodes of supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has unspecified atrial fibrillation
Symptoms have not been adequately characterized by standard resting electrocardiograms
A cardiac event monitor is ordered
The monitor is intended to capture arrhythmic episodes during daily activities
The monitor is intended to guide further management and rate control strategies
